capabilities: Fetch articles from RSS feeds and save them as Markdown files
Manage multiple RSS feeds from settings
Update feeds automatically on a periodic schedule
Customize file names and note content with template variables
Add frontmatter and hashtags to generated article notes
extras: Auto-delete of old articles depends on the publish_date and saved_date frontmatter keys, so custom templates must preserve them.
problem: Obsidian cannot pull articles from RSS feeds into the vault on its own, so readers must clip or copy content manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by the implementation of joethei/obsidian-rss.

summary: Downloads RSS feed articles into the vault as Markdown files, with custom file name and content templates, frontmatter, tags, and periodic updates.
